answer.outline: Invalid submissions do not persist data and explain what to fix; a valid submission redirects to a GET route and displays confirmation.
suggested_steps: Treat an absent field and an empty string separately.
Validate lengths and formats on the server, not only in HTML.
Use Flask-WTF or another maintained approach for CSRF protection before production.
